title: Fix Kilo Quota | OpenRouter error handling and retry flow
author: Neonsy
lessons: AI SDK error stream parts are not optional -- fullStream can emit terminal { type: 'error' } parts that must be handled
SDK field name conventions vary -- status vs statusCode vs $metadata.httpStatusCode; error handlers need a priority chain
Generic wrapper messages need unwrapping -- 'No output generated' hides the real message in responseBody.error.message
Community screenshots provide concrete evidence for error-handling PRs
